cards.title: Timing Chain
cards.body: We inspect and replace timing chain components as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Bearings
cards.body: We replace main bearings and connecting rod bearings as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Gaskets & Seals
cards.body: We replace all gaskets and seals as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Twin-Scroll Turbocharger
cards.body: The AJ133's twin-scroll turbocharger is a key component that is removed, inspected, and refurbished or replaced as part of the rebuild.

cards.title: Additional Inspected Components
cards.body: Fuel injectors, high-pressure fuel pump, PCV system, timing chain tensioners and guides, and cooling system components are all measured and inspected.

notice: Components drawn directly from VRF Key Components data. If your AJ133's exact ancillary set isn't covered above, we confirm the full scope once your engine is inspected — not guessed in advance.

groups.title: Replaced as Standard
items: Timing chain assembly (chains, guides, tensioners) — critical known issue
Main bearings and connecting rod bearings

groups.title: Inspected and Measured
items: Timing chain tensioners and guides (aluminium guide rails weaker than steel tensioners)
Timing chain (can stretch while tensioner/guide combo is failing)
Cam phasers (cam phaser failure is also common)
